study: Stronger teacher, complementary observations and gated self-refresh
purpose: Determine whether stronger automatic labels add value beyond equal-update trusted replay; require a matched frozen-label continuation before crediting refresh.
selection: Metadata only;240 frames from91 setups;58trios+33pairs, no previousPseudo180 frames/scenes

teacher.head: one2many
teacher.scope: single tabletop_item class; no COCO proxy filter
teacher.single_pass: qualifying RGB768 seeds; stable greedy confidence ordering
teacher.ladder: retain single-pass seeds; add qualifying RGB1536 or gray768 seeds supported by a different branch, then same dedup and sharedcap

training.optimizer: AdamW restored with moments and step counters
training.partial_loss: unassigned-anchor BCE masked on partial inputs; positives and boxloss retained
training.trusted_stream: continue same original stream from update301
training.supplemental_stream: new fixed seed+1 permutation through all240 then repeat; identical rowids/pixels/order forS,L,O

arms.T: trusted replay continuation; fourth slot continues original trusted stream
arms.S: same3 trusted plus A single-pass partial fullframe
arms.L: same3 trusted plus A ladder partial fullframe
arms.O: same3 trusted plus complete publisher labels on identical supplemental frames; privileged diagnostic

training.budget_caveat: equal updates and pixels forS/L/O, unequal positive counts; oracle also supplies valid background negatives

teacher_quality_gate.action_on_fail: retain bounded four-arm comparison as diagnostic; no pseudo promotion or recursive refresh of a failing policy; no perbox filtering by groundtruth

evaluation.calibration_rule: most permissive grid cutoff satisfying both T at.25 candidate and unmapped counts; report actual counts on development and regression
evaluation.bootstrap: pairedsetup20000 draws; original100 uses83 connectedsetup clusters
evaluation.forbidden: No Component40 retuning, no Integration30 access

refresh_qualification.compare_against: equal-update trusted T at calibration-controlled operating points
refresh_qualification.candidate_selection: eligibleS/L with greatest development both-view coverage; tie fewer unmapped, thenS
refresh_qualification.if_none: stop recursive learning; interpret oracle and teacher-quality diagnostics; report full100results

conditional_refresh.paired_arms: same eligible600stepcheckpoint+optimizer; unchanged labels vs refreshed teacher labels
conditional_refresh.refresh_label_quality_required: same overallqualitygate; new-to-frozen admittedlabels>=.95 precision and>=50newcorrectendpoints across>=15setups; if no usableincrement stop
conditional_refresh.claim_rule: freshlabels must beat equal-update unchangedlabels by>=1pp with pairedlower95>0 and candidate/unmappedratios<=1.05; also compare trusted reference and unchangedA
conditional_refresh.evaluation_status: all development; no fresh test claim

integration: Only qualifying detector candidates may receive frozenDINO check on fulloriginal100 and development100 using existingcrop recipe andcosine.70; no matchingfine-tune; Integration30 stayssealed
limits: one training seed, one dataset, setup separation not newphysicalobjects, no truckgeneralizationclaim
